chain.title: Demon's Dream Seeds
chain.desc: Dropped when breaking grass; plant them to grow the Demon's Dream herb, the first step into the Otherworld.

chain.title: Demon's Dream Fruit
chain.desc: Harvest Demon's Dream Fruit from your crop. Eating it grants access to the Third Eye effect, while another fruit starts the Spiritfire conversion branch.

chain.title: Light the Otherworld Flame
chain.desc: Drop Demon's Dream Fruit on the ground and ignite it with flint and steel. Use the purple Spiritfire for the Dictionary's conversion recipes, with a clear space around it to retrieve the results. Confirm this checkpoint after lighting a working Spiritfire; you do not need a fire block in your inventory.

chain.title: Otherstone
chain.desc: Made by throwing andesite into Spiritfire; the base stone for sacrificial bowls, pedestals and other ritual furniture.

chain.title: Divination Rod
chain.desc: Crafted from a wooden rod and a Spirit Attuned Gem (a diamond converted in Spiritfire); attune it to a sample block to locate hidden Otherworld trees and ores.

chain.title: Otherworld Wood
chain.desc: Chopped from Otherworld trees, grown from a sapling obtained by burning an oak sapling in Spiritfire or found by divination; burning the log in Spiritfire yields Otherworld Ashes for chalk.

chain.title: Bound Book of Binding: Foliot
chain.desc: Bind a Foliot name into the correct Book of Binding using the Dictionary of Spirits. The bound book identifies the spirit for the ritual; keep different spirit tiers clearly labelled.

chain.title: Bound Book of Binding: Djinni
chain.desc: A Djinni-grade Book of Binding inscribed with a Djinni's true name; the activation item for all Djinni summoning and crafting rituals.

chain.title: White Chalk
chain.desc: Prepare and purify White Chalk, then copy the exact pentacle shown in the Dictionary of Spirits. Rituals depend on the correct pattern and chalk, not simply on having a circle near the bowls.

chain.title: Sacrificial Bowl
chain.desc: Set sacrificial bowls around a clear ritual area. The surrounding bowls hold ingredients, while the golden central bowl receives the ritual's activation item.

chain.title: Purple Chalk
chain.desc: Combine impure white chalk with crushed end stone and obsidian dust, then purify in Spiritfire; draws Afrit-tier pentacles.

chain.title: The Heart of the Pentacle
chain.desc: Place the Golden Sacrificial Bowl at the pentacle's centre. Load the surrounding bowls and use the activation item specified by the selected ritual.

chain.title: First Ritual: the Crusher
chain.desc: Summon a Foliot Crusher with the ritual shown in the Dictionary, then feed it a supported iron ingredient. Collect the resulting dust to confirm the spirit is working before handing it a large batch.

chain.title: Slay an Unbound Afrit
chain.desc: Use the uncontrolled Afrit summoning ritual in a prepared fighting area. Defeat the summoned Afrit and keep its essence for Red Chalk and the deeper mining upgrades.

chain.title: Golden Chalk
chain.desc: Combine impure white chalk with gold dust and glowstone dust, then purify in Spiritfire; required for Djinni-tier pentacles.

chain.title: Red Chalk
chain.desc: Combine impure white chalk with Afrit Essence and blaze powder, then purify in Spiritfire; the final chalk tier, needed for Marid rituals.

chain.title: Otherworld Goggles
chain.desc: Craft the infused lenses through their Djinni ritual and assemble the goggles. Wear them when searching for Otherworld materials so you do not have to rely on repeatedly eating Demon's Dream Fruit.

chain.title: Infused Pickaxe
chain.desc: Use the Djinni crafting ritual to obtain an Infused Pickaxe. This tool and the Third Eye effect let you reach the Iesnium ore needed by the mining branch.

chain.title: Dimensional Storage Actuator
chain.desc: Complete the ritual-made components for the Dimensional Storage Actuator. Build the storage structure from the Dictionary's diagram and test inserting and retrieving a small stack before moving your entire base into it.

chain.title: Iesnium
chain.desc: Locate Iesnium in the Nether while you can see the Otherworld, mine it with a suitable infused tool and process the ore. Reserve the first ingots for the mineshaft and miner equipment.

chain.title: Give the Storage Room to Grow
chain.desc: Add the first Dimensional Storage Stabilizers in the positions shown in the Dictionary. Check the actuator's capacity before filling the expanded network.

chain.title: Iesnium Pickaxe
chain.desc: Crafted normally from three Iesnium ingots and sticks; a durable spirit pickaxe consumed as an ingredient by every miner-spirit ritual.

chain.title: Dimensional Mineshaft
chain.desc: Build the Dimensional Mineshaft and install a bound miner. It is a machine that produces mined items, not a portal you enter; provide output storage and monitor the miner's condition.

chain.title: Foliot Miner
chain.desc: Bind a Foliot miner into its lamp using the listed ritual. Put it to work in the mineshaft and check what it produces before deciding which specialised miner to upgrade toward.

chain.title: Djinni Ore Miner
chain.desc: Upgrade your miner through the Djinni ore-miner ritual. This specialises the output toward ores and provides the starting point for the deeper mining tiers.

chain.title: Below the Familiar Ores
chain.desc: Upgrade the Djinni miner with the Afrit ritual's materials. This intermediate miner connects ordinary ore production to the final Marid mining project.

chain.title: Marid Master Miner
chain.desc: Upgrade the Afrit miner through the final Marid ritual using Red Chalk and the listed rare ingredients. Put the resulting miner into an established mineshaft with enough storage to handle its output.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Spiritfire, chalk and summoning, storage, Iesnium and the complete Foliot-to-Marid miner ladder.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
